title: FANTF: Fuzzy attention network based transformers for time series analysis
abstract: arXiv:2504.00070v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces Fuzzy Attention Network-Based Transformer (FANTF), an approach for time series forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection. FANTF combines fuzzy logic concepts with transformer architectures through a novel fuzzy attention mechanism. The proposed mechanism is inspired by Type-2 fuzzy set theory. It uses a learnable Gaussian uncertainty perturbation to model uncertainty in attention relevance scores. This makes it possible for the model to accurately capture uncertainty in temporal relationships better than normal deterministic attention. Transformers capacity to record complex temporal patterns and multivariate connections is enhanced by FANTF. The approach is both architecture-agnostic and task-agnostic. The proposed fuzzy attention module can be used as a direct replacement for the standard attention layer. To evaluate its effectiveness, FANTF is integrated into five transformer backbones: Transformer,

translated_title: FANTF：基于模糊注意力网络的Transformer用于时间序列分析
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了基于模糊注意力网络的Transformer（FANTF），这是一种用于时间序列预测、分类和异常检测的方法。FANTF通过一种新颖的模糊注意力机制将模糊逻辑概念与Transformer架构相结合。所提出的机制受二型模糊集理论的启发，使用可学习的高斯不确定性扰动来建模注意力相关性得分中的不确定性。这使得模型能够比普通的确定性注意力更准确地捕捉时间关系中的不确定性。FANTF增强了Transformer记录复杂时间模式和多元变量连接的能力。该方法既与架构无关，也与任务无关。所提出的模糊注意力模块可以直接替换标准注意力层。为了评估其有效性，FANTF被集成到五个Transformer骨干网络中：Transformer等。
tldr: 提出了一种基于二型模糊集理论的模糊注意力机制FANTF，利用可学习的高斯不确定性扰动建模注意力得分中的不确定性，可作为标准注意力层的即插即用替代模块，提升Transformer在时间序列预测、分类和异常检测任务上的性能。
en_tdlr: FANTF introduces a fuzzy attention mechanism based on Type-2 fuzzy set theory that uses a learnable Gaussian uncertainty perturbation to model uncertainty in attention scores, serving as a plug-and-play replacement for standard attention layers to enhance transformer performance in time series forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection.
